units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 3:4">Yoma III, 4</cite> <he>קְרָצוֹ ומרק וכ׳</he> he made the ritually required cut, and some one else finished &c., v. <cite ref="M02760"><he>מָרַק</he></cite>.
Ib. 32ᵇ מאי קרצו … לישנא וכ׳ what is meant by ḳ’ratso?… It has the meaning of slaying (by ref. to Jer. XLVI, 20); Y. ib. III, 40ᶜ top, v. נָכוֹסָא.
<cite ref="Tosefta Uktsin 2:8">Tosef. Ukts. II, 8</cite> <he>כיון שקרצו</he> as soon as he has made an incision into it (although he did not cut it apart, v.
Ukts. II, 5).—Esp. to cut dough on the baker’s board.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 15:2">Kel. XV, 2</cite> <he>אם … קוֹרֵץ עליו</he> if he prepares it to cut dough on it; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 5:4">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. V, 4</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 4:9:2">Y. Pes. IV, 31ᵇ</cite> top <he>מודיי שקורצין</he>, read: <he>שקוצרין</he>.]
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 6:12">Nidd. VI, 12</cite> <he>כדי לִקְרוֹץ בצפורן</he> a hair large enough to seize with the nails.

senses.gloss: [to form a groove,] to press the lips close together; to gesticulate with closed lips.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 8:5">Mikv. VIII, 5</cite> <he>קָרְצָה שפתותיה</he> if (in taking a ritual immersion) she pressed her lips together.—

<cite ref="Yoma 19b:7">Yoma 19ᵇ</cite> <he>הקורא … ולא יִקְרוֹץ בשפתותיו</he> reading the Sh’mʿa one must not blink with one’s eyes, nor gesticulate with one’s lips &c. (make motions to his neighbor).

senses.gloss: <cite ref="S02140">same</cite>. Ib. <he>הקורא … ומְקָרֵץ וכ׳</he> of him who reads the Shmʿa and blinks with his eyes and gesticulates with his lips and points with his fingers, the Scriptures say, ‘not me didst thou call &c.’ (<cite ref="Isaiah 43:22">Is. XLIII, 22</cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 318">Yalk. Is. 318</cite>) <he>וקוֹרֵץ</he>.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 7:4">Peah VII, 4</cite> <he>אם נִקְרֶצֶת עם וכ׳</he> if it (the isolated bunch on the knee of a vine) can be nipped off as a cluster, it belongs to the owner (Ms. M. <he>נקצרת</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); Sifra K’dosh., Par. 1, ch. III (Var. <he>נקצרת</he>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 605:2">Yalk. Lev. 605</cite> <he>נקצרת</he>; Y. Peah VII, 20ᵃ bot. <he>אני אומר את הנִקְרָצוֹת עם האשכולות</he> (not <he>עם</he>) I mean those which have been nipped off in clusters; a. e.
